arguments.Title: 복귀 구간 물리 접촉 진단
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var v=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>(); var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); if(v==null)return; result.Log("position="+v.transform.position+" driving="+c.IsDriving+" target="+c.LastTargetSpeedKmh+" reason="+c.DiagnosticReason); foreach(var w in v.GetComponentsInChildren<WheelCollider>()) result.Log("wheel="+w.name+" motor="+w.motorTorque+" brake="+w.brakeTorque+" rpm="+w.rpm); foreach(var box in v.GetComponentsInChildren<BoxCollider>()) foreach(var other in Physics.OverlapBox(box.bounds.center,box.bounds.extents+Vector3.one*.1f)) { if(other.transform.IsChildOf(v.transform))continue; Vector3 dir; float depth; if(Physics.ComputePenetration(box,box.transform.position,box.transform.rotation,other,other.transform.position,other.transform.rotation,out dir,out depth)) result.Log("contact="+other.name+" depth="+depth+" dir="+dir); } var h=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); h.OperatorControls.SelectVehicle("V01"); ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot("artifacts/high_speed_drive/request-ui-stalled.png"); } }
